notes: Fix: Sonos multi zone addressing. A multi hosts several zones behind one IP separated only by port (:1400/:1500/:1600/:1700); discovery threw the port away and all SOAP hardcoded :1400, so three of four zones were unreachable and the UI showed one room while another changed volume. Port is now carried through discovery, persistence, control and coordinator resolution, and /api/select keys on zone name. Also: a board no longer auto-grabs speakers[0] when its assigned zone is missing -- it holds the assignment, warns, and retries every 30s until the zone returns or you assign another.
